title: SCPN FRC Core
description: Governed device-family repository for the field-reversed configuration within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, level-0 device physics (the radial pressure balance across the separatrix and the empirical S*/E kinetic-scale bound), and tessellated and B-rep device models with the separatrix as a closed surface and a normalised STEP export. All parameter sets are synthetic; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
